method: targeted runtime import and literal-reference scan on the clean deployment worktree, followed by execution-flow inspection

class_importers.providers: backend/providers/__init__.py is the only runtime importer of the fourteen transferred provider classes
class_importers.scrapers: backend/scrapers/__init__.py is the only runtime importer of FinancejobsScraper and IrishJobsScraper

generic_consumers: backend/tasks/fetch_tasks.py obtains producers through the provider registry
backend/tasks/scraping_tasks.py obtains producers through the scraper registry
backend/tasks/watchlist_tasks.py derives school health sources from the scraper registry
backend/services/harvest_window.py is consulted only by the legacy fetch and scrape persistence paths
verified_runtime_flow.public_jobs_api: reads persisted jobs and does not import any transferred producer class
verified_runtime_flow.database_history: existing jobs, compliance rows and immutable Alembic migrations do not require producer implementations to remain importable

atomic_control_plane_dependency.finding: disabled_sources rejects configured names that are absent from a registry; deleting registry entries while preserving the 14+2 environment lists would abort BFF startup and producer construction
atomic_control_plane_dependency.required_change: remove the registry entries, 14+2 environment values, handover settings/helper/startup guard and deployment enforcement in one release; simplify the remaining registries to direct construction

shared_behavior: generic persisted-job normalization and repository behavior still used by retained producers or historical rows
school watchlist health, manual refresh and alerts
immutable migrations and historical audit records

delete: the seventeen full-delete modules enumerated in code-simplification-baseline.json
tests dedicated only to retired producer implementations or handover configuration
edit: remove transferred imports and registry entries while retaining all producers listed above
remove transferred entries from backend/services/harvest_window.py and update its registry-completeness tests
remove only transferred-producer cases from mixed test modules
make backend/tasks/watchlist_tasks.py derive all swiss_schools_* entries directly
remove the obsolete 14+2 configuration fields, generated example values, manifest entries and deploy-script enforcement

execution_gates: legacy producer queues and in-flight tasks are drained before worker recreation
Core remains healthy for all sixteen transferred sources
post-release registries contain exactly the retained producers and all eight school collectors
BFF and worker start without LEGACY_DISABLED_PROVIDERS or LEGACY_DISABLED_SCRAPERS
no transferred producer starts network I/O and retained producers still do
conclusion: The producer cleanup is a single cohesive removal after rollback closure. Splitting registry deletion from its handover control plane is unsafe; retaining the control plane after its last use is unnecessary.
